sloka: एवमुक्तवतो वाक्यं कुम्भकर्णस्य धीमतः।प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं प्रहसन् राक्षसाधिपः ।। ६.६५.९ ।।
transliteration: evamuktavato vākyaṁ kumbhakarṇasya dhīmataḥ।pratyuvāca tato vākyaṁ prahasan rākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 6.65.9 ।।

translations.english: Wise Kumbhakarna having spoken in that way, the Rakshasa king, Ravana laughed and replied in this way.
